Manifest.Name: 店铺助手 / Shop Assist
Manifest.Author: loyce
Manifest.Description: 让柜台、库存和每天的安排更有条理。右键收银机打开设置，查看库存、账单、待办和鉴定辅助。支持中文与英文，跟随游戏语言。 / Stock and organize your shop, keep a daily ledger, track tasks, and get appraisal hints. Right-click the register for settings. Chinese and English follow the game language.
